facts.fact: Ch 8: Meera tells Rohan she saw a crown stamp scraped off the crates and never asked whose; she buys through a lowland middleman who sells via the lower-lane runners (matches F205/F211). She marks a round sieve-print beside his entry in the count.
Ch 8: one night's fire is five sticks; the next woodpile lies two days' walk past the Rope-Hut; the warden mess serves sattu unsalted.
Ch 8: Meera decides not to wake Rohan about the torches and to tell him at dawn.
